title: The canal
subtitle: Jump it, wade it, or take the plank.

sections.name: Bund
sections.note: The bund path between the paddies: the rooster struts ahead; tap to chase.

sections.name: FirstCanal
sections.note: The first canal, 2.5 m: a held jump clears it; the rooster flutters across first.

sections.name: Plank
sections.note: A 3.5 m canal, too wide for a sure jump: the plank bridge is the way across.

sections.name: Dung
sections.note: Cow dung on the bund, as in the lane: a tap clears it.

sections.name: Haystack
sections.note: A small haystack: hop onto it (mangoes along its top) or over it.

sections.name: WideCanal
sections.note: The widest canal, 4.5 m: double jump (the mangoes show where), or wade.

sections.name: Breather
sections.note: Room to breathe: a wave of mangoes and the first chilli.

sections.name: Cart
sections.note: The bullock cart on the bund: onto its bed; a feather above it for a double jump.

sections.name: CanalDung
sections.note: A canal, then dung: jump, land, tap.

sections.name: Haystacks
sections.note: Three small haystacks: hop, hop, hop; a feather above the last.

sections.name: PlankThenJump
sections.note: The plank, then a canal with no plank: walk, then jump.

sections.name: ChilliStraight
sections.note: A long straight and a chilli to win back ground.

sections.name: CartCanal
sections.note: Off the cart's bed and straight on over a canal.

sections.name: WideAgain
sections.note: The wide canal again: double jump.

sections.name: DungHaystack
sections.note: Dung, then a small haystack.

sections.name: CanalTrio
sections.note: Three 2.5 m canals in a rhythm: jump, jump, jump.

sections.name: Mischief
sections.note: Dung; then the rooster knocks the pots by the well into the lane; a canal after.

sections.name: PlankHaystack
sections.note: The plank, then a haystack.

sections.name: ChilliRun
sections.note: A chilli and a run of mangoes.

sections.name: CanalCartCanal
sections.note: Canal, cart, canal.

sections.name: WideHaystack
sections.note: The wide canal, then a haystack straight after it.

sections.name: DungPair
sections.note: Two cow pats: tap, tap.

sections.name: FinalChilli
sections.note: The last chilli.

sections.name: ThreeWidths
sections.note: All three canals in a row: jump the 2.5 m, walk the plank, double jump the 4.5 m.

sections.name: HaystackDung
sections.note: Two haystacks and dung between them.

sections.name: Sugarcane
sections.note: Past the sugarcane: a canal, then dung.

sections.name: LastWide
sections.note: The last wide canal, and a haystack after it.

sections.name: OpenBund
sections.note: The bund opens out: if he is still ahead, he gets away at 600 m.
